sqlserver.approved_orders_query: SELECT TOP (5000) LTRIM(RTRIM(h.OrderNo)) AS order_no, CONVERT(char(10), h.OrderDate, 23) AS order_date, CONVERT(char(10), CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, '19000107', DATEADD(day, 1, h.OrderDate)) % 7 = 0 THEN DATEADD(day, 2, h.OrderDate) ELSE DATEADD(day, 1, h.OrderDate) END, 23) AS delivery_date, TRY_CONVERT(float, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(h.Paymentinday)), '')) AS payment_in_day, LTRIM(RTRIM(h.CustomerCode)) AS customer_code, h.CustomerName AS customer_name, CAST(h.BillingAddress AS nvarchar(250)) AS billing_address, CAST(h.ShippingAddress AS nvarchar(400)) AS shipping_address, LTRIM(RTRIM(h.CustomerCode)) AS delivery_point_code, 'TS-h01' AS pickup_hub_code, h.LocationName AS pickup_hub_name, h.SalesPerson AS sale_code, h.SalesName AS sale_name, d.ItemOrder AS line_no, LTRIM(RTRIM(d.ItemCode)) AS item_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.ItemName)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(d.Description AS nvarchar(180)))), ''), LTRIM(RTRIM(d.ItemCode))) AS description, CAST(d.MainQuantity AS float) AS quantity, CAST(d.UnitPrice AS float) AS unit_price, d.MainUnit AS main_unit, CAST(d.NW AS float) AS nw, CAST(d.M3 AS float) AS cbm FROM dbo.SalesOrderHdr h JOIN dbo.SalesOrderDtl d ON d.TransactionNo = h.TransactionNo WHERE h.IsApprSo = 1 AND LTRIM(RTRIM(h.Company)) = 'TST' AND ISNULL(h.IsCancel, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(h.IsClosed, 0) = 0 AND h.OrderDate >= '2026-09-16' ORDER BY h.OrderNo, d.ItemOrder
sqlserver.totals_query: SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(h.OrderNo)) AS order_no, CAST(h.TotalAmount AS float) AS total_amount, CAST(h.TotalActualAmount AS float) AS total_actual_amount FROM dbo.SalesOrderHdr h WHERE h.IsApprSo = 1 AND ISNULL(h.IsCancel,0)=0 AND ISNULL(h.IsClosed,0)=0 AND h.OrderDate >= '2026-09-16'
